title: Block to SoC: VIP Modes
description: Reuse the SPI block's APB register-port agent in passive mode so it monitors traffic driven by the SoC's processor without bus contention, and prove from the log that it is watching the right bus.

steps.title: Step 1: Observe the Active Agent Failure
steps.instructions: Run `testbench.sv` unchanged. In the topology, find the `driver` and `sequencer` under `uvm_test_top.env.spi_env.spi_agent`. Then find the `UVM_ERROR [APB_X]` messages (the driver and the CPU both drive the APB nets, which resolve to X), the missing BOOT_DONE line, `[FW_TIMEOUT]` and `[TRAFFIC_COUNT]`.

steps.title: Step 2: Flip to Passive Mode
steps.instructions: In `soc_test::build_phase`, set `is_active` to `UVM_PASSIVE` with `uvm_config_db#(uvm_active_passive_enum)::set` at the exact path `"env.spi_env.spi_agent"`. Rerun: the topology shows only the monitor, and the run stops with `UVM_FATAL [SEQ]` at the first `start_item()`, because the copied block sequence is started on a null sequencer handle.

steps.title: Step 3: Give the Bus to Firmware and Audit the Build
steps.instructions: Remove the block bring-up sequence from `soc_test::run_phase`, and add a `UVM_FATAL [MODE]` check in `end_of_elaboration_phase` unless the agent is passive. Rerun: expect BOOT_DONE and FW_PASS from the mailbox decoder, `spi_agent monitor saw 5 transfers`, `SCB_SUMMARY matches=1 mismatches=0 pending=0`, and zero errors and fatals.

steps.title: Step 4: Prove the Evidence Check Works
steps.instructions: In `tb_top`, temporarily publish `spare_bus` instead of `apb_bus` as the agent's `vif`. Rerun and confirm that `[TRAFFIC_COUNT]` names the disconnected monitor (0 transfers instead of 5). Restore `apb_bus`.

steps.title: Step 5: Drill the Forgotten super.build_phase
steps.instructions: Temporarily comment out `super.build_phase(phase);` in `spi_apb_agent::build_phase`. Rerun: the topology shows the driver and sequencer again and your audit stops the run with `UVM_FATAL [MODE]`, because `uvm_agent` reads `is_active` only in its own `build_phase`. Restore the line.
